title: We have shrewridden Shakespeare and henpecked Socrates
html_source: Stephen has previously discussed (in the Scylla and Charybdis chapter) that Shakespeare was mistreated by his wife Anne Hathaway and that Socrates was mistreated by his wife Xanthippe.
